diagnosis_definitions.data_quality_issue: all channel voltages are exactly 0 at the same instant (readout/telemetry glitch pattern) or inputs missing
diagnosis_definitions.persistent_channel_deviation: flagged in >= persistence_fraction of the last window_seconds of this channel (causal)
diagnosis_definitions.statistical_anomaly: score > threshold; no dominant output-level feature or direction
diagnosis_definitions.suspected_high_output: flagged and the dominant deviating output feature is ABOVE its neighbours
diagnosis_definitions.suspected_low_output: flagged and the dominant deviating output feature is BELOW its neighbours (V, I or relative-to-sibling)
